def grantapi.transition
  (db : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : Std.U64)
  (req : grantapi.Request) :
  Result (model.Db × (core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind))
  := do
  match req with
  | grantapi.Request.CreateGrant resource subject role expires_at =>
    grantapi.create_grant db env caller resource subject role expires_at
  | grantapi.Request.SetRole resource subject role expires_at =>
    grantapi.set_role_handler db env caller resource subject role expires_at
  | grantapi.Request.RevokeGrant grant_id =>
    grantapi.revoke_grant db env caller grant_id

theorem set_member_role_personal (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.set_member_role db env caller d s role e = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by
  unfold grantapi.set_member_role at h
  simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r, _, hgates⟩ := h
  cases r with
  | Err err1 =>
    simp only [db_clone, bind_ok, ok.injEq] at hgates
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hres⟩ := hgates
    subst hw
    dsimp only at hres
    simp only [ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hres
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hres
    exact ⟨rfl, err1, rfl⟩
  | Ok u =>
    simp only [refuse_if_personal_eq db d dr hr hk, bind_ok, db_clone, ok.injEq] at hgates
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hres⟩ := hgates
    subst hw
    dsimp only at hres
    simp only [ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hres
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hres
    exact ⟨rfl, _, rfl⟩

theorem create_grant_personal (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.create_grant db env caller (.Drive d) s role e = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by
  unfold grantapi.create_grant at h
  simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r1, _, hrest⟩ := h
  cases r1 with
  | Err err1 =>
    simp only [db_clone, bind_ok, ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hrest
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hrest
    exact ⟨rfl, err1, rfl⟩
  | Ok u1 =>
    simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at hrest
    obtain ⟨r2, _, hrest2⟩ := hrest
    cases r2 with
    | Err err2 =>
      simp only [db_clone, bind_ok, ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hrest2
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hrest2
      exact ⟨rfl, err2, rfl⟩
    | Ok u2 =>
      dsimp only at hrest2
      exact set_member_role_personal db db' env caller d s role e dr hr hk out hrest2

theorem set_role_handler_personal (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.set_role_handler db env caller (.Drive d) s role e = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by

  simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r1, _, hrest⟩ := h
  cases r1 with
  | Err err1 =>
    simp only [db_clone, bind_ok, ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hrest
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hrest
    exact ⟨rfl, err1, rfl⟩
  | Ok u1 =>
    dsimp only at hrest
    exact set_member_role_personal db db' env caller d s role e dr hr hk out hrest

theorem personal_drive_members_fixed (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (hq : req = .CreateGrant (.Drive d) s role e ∨ req = .SetRole (.Drive d) s role e)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller req = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by
  unfold grantapi.transition at h
  cases hq with
  | inl hq =>
    subst hq
    exact create_grant_personal db db' env caller d s role e dr hr hk out h
  | inr hq =>
    subst hq
    exact set_role_handler_personal db db' env caller d s role e dr hr hk out h
